executive_summary: The scan of the staging‑DP platform (https://stg-dp-mgr.abafusion.ai/connectors) found nine live endpoints and eleven informational findings, with **zero critical or high‑severity issues**. All test payloads—including boundary checks, empty bodies, XXE, SSTI, open‑redirect, SSRF, NoSQL injection, and command injection—were rejected with **HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity** responses, confirming that the API correctly validates input and blocks these attack vectors. The consistent 422 status across all categories demonstrates effective server‑side validation and sanitisation. No evidence of successful exploitation or data leakage was observed in the response bodies. Consequently, the current security posture of the staging environment is acceptable, though continued monitoring and periodic re‑testing are recommended to maintain this level of protection.
